title: Board Modifier Selection Modes
description: Board selection: add replace (default) merge mode; modifier chords Ctrl=subtractive, Shift=additive, Ctrl+Shift=invertive override toolbar mode on pointer; extend WASM pointerDownScreen with ctrl/meta flag; remove shift+empty pan (middle-button pan only). Update play toolbar default to replace and add Replace control.
summary: WASM pointerMoveScreen/pointerUpScreen now take shift+ctrl_or_meta; marquee recomputes merge mode every move and on up. Removed stale merge_mode from Interaction::Selection. BoardRenderer passes modifier keys from PointerEvent; while isDraggingAreaSelect, window keydown/keyup (capture) re-sends pointerMove at last screen coords so modifier-only chord changes update the live selection. lostpointercapture + detach disarm the bridge. Vitest covers shift mid–rectangle drag.
